_what: Today's calls that send Trillion-wide work into one person's store (the operator account's PersonStore), per file, each with the duty it still does there. Recorded 2026-10-15 when the guard started, from the measurement of what the operator store answers for everyone. It only shrinks: moving a duty to its own addressed owner (the edge store, a record book addressed by what it owns, a native resource, the native credential issuer) lowers or deletes its file's row in the same commit (test/no-service-work-in-person-store.test.mjs). A row with `allowed_because` is work genuinely addressed to the operator as a person; it may stay, never grow. `patterns` names the shapes this allowance was measured with: shapes are only ever added, and a broader measurement starts its own baseline from the first allowance recorded with it. A row's `runtime_calls` lists the only methods a real run may ask the operator's store (test/service-watch-operator-calls.test.mjs).

duties: the tray report tool hands each report someone sends to Trillion HQ to the operator account (153)
records/workshop-tray-tool-records.json.allowed_because: A report sent to Trillion HQ is addressed to the operator as its recipient; it is their inbox, one message per report.

duties: the default Marketplace publisher is the operator: its maker id is worked out from the setting (4)
src/marketplace-defaults.json.allowed_because: Only a maker identity is computed from the setting and the shared pool is read; no store of the operator is reached.

duties: service_work_setting names the one account the service's own work reaches: a failing watch, a stopped service check or a client health issue handed to its AIs (through that account's own records, RecordBook handServiceWork, not its store), the bill notice told to it (through its own records too, src/service-notice.mjs tellServiceNotice), and the tool steps that need its own connections (the repository for a waiting deploy, a page critique) run on it. The watches' state, and each check's and issue's state and schedule, are kept by their own owners (src/service-checks.mjs, src/client-health.mjs: one record book each).
src/service-watch.json.allowed_because: Each reach is addressed to that account itself: work handed to its own AIs, a notice to the person who runs Trillion, or a tool run on connections only it holds. Nothing it is asked keeps, schedules or runs the service's checks or issues.

duties: the hosted client program names the operator as its host (8)
src/client-program.json.allowed_because: The client program is hosted by the operator as a person: applicants apply to them and they accept clients. The list of programs every account reads comes from the edge store (service record client-programs), never their store.
